in_sanskrit.name: धरिन्या
in_sanskrit.meaning: One who upholds, supports, or preserves
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: धरति (dharati) - to uphold, support, preserve + न्या (nya) - one who

in_hindi.name: धरिन्या

in_tamil.name: தரின்யா
in_tamil.long_meaning: தர் (tar) - to hold, support + இன்யா (inya) - one who is with you

in_telugu.name: ధరిన్యా
in_telugu.long_meaning: ధరతి (dharati) - to uphold, support + న్యా (nya) - one who is needed

in_marathi.name: Dharinya
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dharinya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Dharini is the Goddess who is the embodiment of earth and stability. She is the one who holds and nurtures the universe. In Hindu mythology, she is often depicted as the consort of Lord Shiva and is believed to bestow prosperity and blessings upon her devotees.

in_bengali.name: Dharinya

in_bengali.long_meaning: Dharinya একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Dharini is the Goddess who is the embodiment of earth and stability. She is the one who holds and nurtures the universe. In Hindu mythology, she is often depicted as the consort of Lord Shiva and is believed to bestow prosperity and blessings upon her devotees.
